speaker: juno
text: Kade, it's Juno. You're on the ground and I'm at a safe altitude, which is my favourite kind.

speaker: juno
text: Mira's last ping came from the research outpost, three klicks north. Follow the trail.

speaker: kade
text: Copy. If my sister's out here, I'll find her.

speaker: juno
text: Checkpoint flag. Somebody left supplies. Don't ask who, just take them.

speaker: juno
text: Hold up. That's a camera in the mud. Kade... it's Mira's.

speaker: kade
text: Footage is half gone. But she's laughing. She's working with them.

speaker: juno
text: Maybe she had no choice. Maybe she did. Keep moving.

speaker: juno
text: Big heat signature past that wall of vines. I'd say knock, but he looks like the door.

speaker: brute
text: Little engineer. The Commander said you would come. He did not say you would be so small.

speaker: juno
text: That is a very large man with a very large gun. Use the pillars!

speaker: brute
text: Enough! I will bury you in this dirt!

speaker: juno
text: He's angry now. Jump the shockwaves!

speaker: juno
text: He's dazed! The tank on his back, hit it now!

speaker: brute
text: The Bloom... keeps us... strong...

speaker: juno
text: The what now?

speaker: juno
text: Fog's thick, so I'm flying on instruments and spite. The outpost is past these ruins.

speaker: juno
text: The mercenaries here carry grenades and fly drones. I'd complain to their manager.

speaker: juno
text: The bridge is out. There's a patrol boat at the bank with a gun on it. I'm just saying.

speaker: juno
text: I've been reading the logs you found. The Bloom doesn't just glow, Kade. It gets into people's heads.

speaker: kade
text: And Mira's been growing it.

speaker: juno
text: Something's moving in the temple and my scope can't hold on to it. Careful.

speaker: phantom
text: You hear it too. The humming. It tells me you are a threat.

speaker: kade
text: You're a soldier. You have a name under all that.

speaker: phantom
text: I had... a name.

speaker: juno
text: Kade, his vitals read like a sleepwalker. He isn't choosing this. Maybe don't finish him.

speaker: phantom
text: It says... burn you out.

speaker: juno
text: Gas clouds and drones. Keep moving and stay out of the green.

speaker: juno
text: He's failing. Watch the red line, then get clear.

speaker: juno
text: He's down. The humming is fading on my scope. Your call, Kade.

speaker: phantom
text: Sergeant... Elias Reyes. That is my name. I remember rain.

speaker: juno
text: Welcome back, Sergeant. Extraction's on me.

speaker: phantom
text: Quiet... finally... quiet.

speaker: juno
text: ...Right. Moving on.

speaker: juno
text: Every soldier he has left is between you and that gate. No pressure.

speaker: kade
text: I didn't come this far to turn around.

speaker: juno
text: That gate's on a keypad. Find the terminal and I'll talk you through the hack.

speaker: juno
text: Halfway. For the record, I'm proud of you. Don't make it weird.

speaker: juno
text: Courtyard ahead. Something with four legs just powered up. I miss the large man.

speaker: commander
text: Engineer. You think I am the villain of this valley.

speaker: commander
text: The Bloom keeps men from tearing each other apart. I am guarding it from people far worse than me.

speaker: kade
text: Then you won't mind if I ask my sister.

speaker: commander
text: You will have to get past the walker.

speaker: commander
text: Shield generator down. Impressive. Irrelevant.

speaker: juno
text: Searchlight! Stay out of the beam or it rains mortars.

speaker: commander
text: The core! Keep away from the core!

speaker: juno
text: He said the quiet part out loud. Shoot the core!

speaker: commander
text: If it falls into their hands... remember that I tried to hold the line.

speaker: mira
text: Kade? You came all this way.

speaker: kade
text: You were working with him.

speaker: mira
text: I was. The Bloom calms minds. It also keeps this whole valley alive. I thought I could choose which.

speaker: mira
text: There is a kill switch, and there is a containment seal. I can't decide. You have to.

speaker: phantom
text: There's a third way. The river. I remember the river.

speaker: mira
text: Reyes? The water... it strips the spores and leaves the rest. Kade, he's right.

speaker: juno
text: Riflemen ahead. They like cover. You like them out of it.

speaker: juno
text: Machetes! They're fast and they're loud. Don't let them get close.

speaker: juno
text: Red laser means a sniper is lining you up. Move when the dot stops moving.

speaker: juno
text: Grenadier! A red ring on the ground means leave.

speaker: juno
text: Scout drones. Fragile, annoying, a lot like my ex.

speaker: juno
text: Shield trooper! Bullets bounce off the front, so flank him or shoot the legs.

speaker: juno
text: You're bleeding all over my rescue. Find cover and breathe.

speaker: juno
text: Vitals are ugly, Kade. Get behind something solid.

speaker: juno
text: Do not die. I already spent the advance.

speaker: juno
text: Three for three. Show-off.

speaker: juno
text: That's some shooting for a bridge builder.

speaker: juno
text: Remind me never to play darts with you.

speaker: juno
text: That one parted your hair!

speaker: juno
text: Too close. Way too close.

speaker: juno
text: Nice dodge. Do that every time.

speaker: juno
text: They're running out of soldiers faster than I'm running out of jokes.

speaker: juno
text: Remind me to stay on your good side.

speaker: juno
text: Kade? Kade! ...Okay. Back to the last flag. Again.

speaker: juno
text: No, no, no. Up you get. The flag's still there.

speaker: juno
text: Quiet. I like quiet.

speaker: juno
text: He never heard a thing. Neither did I, and I was listening.

speaker: juno
text: Intel. I'll add it to the codex.

speaker: juno
text: Another log. Keep them coming.

speaker: juno
text: Got it. Reading while flying. Very safe.

speaker: juno
text: Is that a golden idol? Who hides those in a jungle? Besides everyone.

speaker: juno
text: You're on the gun. I'd say aim, but it has plenty of bullets.

speaker: juno
text: Stay on the terminal. They will not like this.

speaker: juno
text: Rain's coming in. They'll see less and hear less. So will you.

speaker: soldier_a
text: Contact!

speaker: soldier_a
text: Intruder on the trail!

speaker: soldier_b
text: He's here!

speaker: soldier_b
text: There! By the trees!

speaker: soldier_c
text: Eyes on target.

speaker: soldier_a
text: I'm hit!

speaker: soldier_b
text: Agh! Medic!

speaker: soldier_c
text: Armour's holding!

speaker: soldier_a
text: Man down!

speaker: soldier_b
text: They got Ortiz!

speaker: soldier_b
text: Frag out!

speaker: soldier_b
text: Eat this!

speaker: soldier_a
text: Falling back!

speaker: soldier_a
text: Cover me!

speaker: soldier_b
text: Cut him down!

speaker: soldier_b
text: For the Bloom!

speaker: soldier_a
text: Hold still...

speaker: soldier_a
text: Got you in my sights.

speaker: soldier_a
text: Three days of rain. Three.

speaker: soldier_b
text: I didn't sign up to guard a flower.

speaker: soldier_c
text: Quiet tonight. I hate quiet.

speaker: soldier_a
text: He's a demon!

speaker: soldier_b
text: I can't stop him!

speaker: soldier_a
text: Thought I heard something.

speaker: soldier_c
text: Check the bushes.

speaker: juno
text: You got her out. That was the job. The rest... we'll carry it. Juno out.

speaker: juno
text: She chose to stay, Kade. That's not losing her. Probably. Juno out.

speaker: juno
text: Everybody lives and the flower behaves. I didn't know we were allowed to win like that. Juno out.
